id.description: Catalog path, prefixed m/: manufacturer slug/first year/model slug

markets.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes, or EU

type_detail.description: Tadpole: a three-wheeler with two wheels in front rather than behind; bench_seat: a moped-style bike; seated: an e-scooter; self_balancing_scooter: side-by-side wheels steered by a bar; step_through: a frame with a low or no top tube

stock_photo.description: Bikebook-hosted copy of the manufacturer's product photo

sources.description: URLs parsed from, in parse order

final_year.description: Last year the model was still offered (latest snapshot year); nil while still current

url.description: Product page URL, from the most authoritative source stating one

url_live.description: Whether the manufacturer's page is still up; false for an archive capture, which shows it as it was

url_is_official.description: Whether the URL is a manufacturer page (vs a third-party review)

years.description: One record per model year, keyed by year, newest first

material_detail.description: The manufacturer's name for its material or grade, e.g. Reynolds 853 steel or FACT 11m carbon

folding.description: Half_fold: one hinge mid-frame, the halves side by side; triangle_fold: the rear triangle swings under (Brompton); umbrella_fold: collapses lengthwise to stand upright (Strida); stem_fold: only the handlebar stem folds, onto the deck; couplers: the frame separates into pieces

position.description: The wheel a rack or fender mount serves

sizes.description: The sizes that have it, when not every size, named as in sizes[].name

location.description: Downtube, under_downtube, seat_tube, top_tube, under_top_tube, fork_legs; a type's repeated place takes _2, _3…

holes.description: Bolt holes, when not the usual 2 (3 for a three-pack cage)

cable_routing.description: Dropper: only the dropper post's cable runs inside the frame; internal: through ports in the frame; stealth: through the headset or stem

shell.description: E.g. BSA, T47, BB92 or threaded

spindle.description: E.g. square taper, DUB, GXP or 24mm

headset.description: SHIS, upper | lower, e.g. ZS44/28.6 | ZS56/40 or EC34/28.6-26tpi | EC34/30 H13.7

front_derailleur_mount.description: E.g. braze-on, direct mount or none

derailleur_hanger.description: E.g. SRAM UDH or the manufacturer's part number

max_weight_total.description: System weight limit: bike, rider and cargo, in kilograms

positions.description: The positions suspended, whether or not their travel is stated

sizes.description: The sizes that take it, when not every size, named as in sizes[].name

configured.description: False for a wheel the frame takes that the complete build doesn't come with

axle_standard.description: E.g. Syntace X-12, Kabolt or Deadbolt

cassette_interface.description: The freehub or driver body a rear wheel's cassette mounts on; hg_road is Shimano's 11/12-speed road body

max_tire_width.description: Widest tire the frame or fork clears at this bsd, in millimeters

wheels.description: One per bead seat diameter each position takes

drivetrain.description: Position-qualified gear count or internal hub (e.g. '12 Rear', '12 Internal Rear'), or special (Fixed/Belt Drive/etc.); a pedalled rear gear comes with its front, '1 Front' for a single chainring

front.description: Teeth on each chainring, smallest first

rear.description: Teeth on each cog, smallest first; at least the smallest and largest

sizes.description: The sizes that have it, when not every size, named as in sizes[].name

spindle.description: A mid drive's crank interface, e.g. ISIS

rated_power.description: Continuous/nominal, basis for legal class, in watts

e_vehicle_classifications.description: The classifications riding in this mode puts it in, by their db/e_vehicle_classifications ids: a jurisdiction's own, and the groups it fits

type.description: Load-area form: Tail types sit behind the rider; Front Box is a walled front load area, Front Platform a flat sideless front deck

seat_tube_ctc.description: Seat Tube C to C, in millimeters

travel_front.description: Fork travel at this size, when it varies by size, in millimeters

travel_rear.description: Rear wheel travel at this size, when it varies by size, in millimeters

total_weight.description: Total vehicle weight at this size, in kilograms

max_weight_rider.description: Max total payload (rider + cargo), in kilograms

extra_measurements.description: Non-canonical measurements, gathered on coerce; another unit only where the key names it, in millimeters

diameter.description: Clamp diameter for bars, stems and seatposts; bead seat diameter for rims, tires and wheels, in millimeters

travel.description: A fork's or shock's travel; how far a dropper or telescoping seatpost adjusts, in millimeters

offset.description: Rake on forks; setback on seatposts, in millimeters

adjustable.description: The least and most of a field the part adjusts through, in place of its fixed value; a negative offset is forward

extra_measurements.description: Non-canonical dimensions, gathered on coerce, in millimeters

angle.description: The component's own angle, e.g. a stem's rise, in degrees

adjustable.description: The least and most of a field the part adjusts through, in place of its fixed value; a negative offset is forward

extra_measurements.description: Non-canonical angles, gathered on coerce, in degrees
